periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Approximately 45-degree diagonal tilt relative to the horizontal facial axis, sloping downward toward the muzzle.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Elongated oval with a length significantly greater than width along the primary diagonal axis.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Pronounced tapering at the inferior-medial margin, extending toward the nasal region.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Shallow U-shaped curve with a relatively smooth posterior margin across the dorsal midline.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: Broad band occupying approximately one-third of the visible torso length at the lateral flanks.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide separation across the cranial vault, with a gap exceeding the width of a single pinna.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Highly smooth, semi-circular curvature at the superior margins.

other_distinctive_markers: Visible brownish-yellow staining/soiling on the white fur of the posterior dorsal and flank regions.
